label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled host parameter flows to URL construction at line 44. Although DNS resolution occurs at line 43 with isNonPublicAddress check, the actual HTTP connection uses the original hostname string (not validated IP). This creates a DNS rebinding window where initial DNS lookup may pass but subsequent connection targets internal resources. Resolved sink value at line 44 is http://<user-host>/v1 where <user-host> comes directly from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest').

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, DNS check done but actual URL uses original hostname string allowing SSRF/DNS rebinding
